why_next: The localhost chunked TE story is now complete: decompression-normalization preserves body-only discrimination at 0.5 through end-to-end chunked TE (origin->proxy->client) in PASSTHROUGH and AUTH-AWARE CACHED modes. The sole remaining blocker for C-MEAS-VALID decompression-normalization product readiness is real CDN infrastructure. Real CDN introduces Accept-Encoding negotiation, quality variation, geographic latency, CDN-specific header manipulation, and multi-layer encoding — none replicated by localhost mock. Testing on real CDN is the minimum next step. The CL-PASSTHROUGH regression contamination (audit V1) should be fixed in a separate orthogonal experiment.
